basic_details.job_title: ECHS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Ayurveda Doctor, Ayurveda Pharmacist Posts
basic_details.short_information: Two contractual posts, one Ayurveda Doctor and one Ayurveda Pharmacist, are to be filled at ECHS Polyclinic Bhopal by the Station Headquarters (ECHS Cell) Bhopal of the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (Bhutpurva Sainik Anshdayi Swasthya Yojana), Ministry of Defence, Government of India. Applications in the format given on the ECHS website must be submitted to the OIC, Stn HQ (ECHS Cell), Sultania Infantry Lines, Bhopal, PIN 462001 by 14 November 2026; any application received after 1200 hrs on 14 November 2026 will not be accepted. The interview is on 20 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About ECHS Bhopal
content_sections.text: The Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) works under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. This notice is issued by its Station Headquarters (ECHS Cell) Bhopal, which can be reached on 0755-2731057, and the posts are for the ECHS Polyclinic Bhopal. The notice invites Ayurveda staff on a contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be made in the requisite format given on the ECHS website, www.echs.gov.in , which also carries the terms and conditions and remuneration details for these posts. The application, with its enclosures, is to be submitted to this address: OIC, Stn HQ (ECHS Cell), Sultania Infantry Lines, Bhopal, PIN 462001 The last date of receipt is 14 November 2026. Any application received after 1200 hrs on 14 November 2026 will not be accepted, so a posted application must reach the office before that time. The notice does not mention a particular postal mode or what to write on the envelope. Only candidates meeting the Qualitative Requirement may apply.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen for these posts. The notice gives no age limit in years; it says only that the contract may be renewed till attaining the maximum age. BAMS degree from a College recognized by National Commission of Indian System of Medicine (NCISM). Minimum of 03 years of relevant work experience after completion of internship. Valid registration with National Commission for Indian System of Medicine or equivalent State Medicine Board/Council. Pay: 95,000/- per month (fixed remuneration). B. Pharma or D Pharma (Ayurveda) from a College recognized by Central/State Govt under the extant provisions/regulations. Minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience. Valid registration as per extant provisions/regulations in the concerned State/UT. Pay: 36,500/- per month (fixed remuneration). For the full terms and conditions of each post, candidates should see the official notification and the ECHS website. The engagement is on a contractual basis for the balance period of FY 2026-2027, i.e. up to 31 Mar 2027 only. It is renewable for an additional period / till attaining the maximum age, subject to the performance of candidates and other conditions, according to the criteria mentioned against the post. On Job Training (OJT) as applicable.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the requisite format given at the ECHS website. Self attested photocopies of testimonials in support of Educational Qualifications. Self attested photocopies of testimonials in support of Work Experience. Medical fitness certificate from SEMO/CMO (Senior Medical Officer / Chief Medical Officer), which must be attached with the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview at Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Bhopal. Only eligible candidates will be intimated by SMS. Interview date: 20 November 2026. Reporting time: candidates must reach Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Bhopal at 0900 hrs. Interview time: between 0930 hrs and 1400 hrs. Bring all original certificates/marks sheets/degree of 10th/Matric, 10+2 and Graduation/Post Graduation/diploma/course, and work experience certificates. Ex-Servicemen must also bring the discharge book, PPO and service records. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ECHS Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 vacancies: 01 Ayurveda Doctor and 01 Ayurveda Pharmacist at ECHS Polyclinic Bhopal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the ECHS Bhopal application?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the OIC, Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Bhopal by 14 November 2026; any application received after 1200 hrs on 14 November 2026 will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the ECHS Bhopal Ayurveda Doctor post?
faq.answer: A BAMS degree from a college recognized by NCISM, a minimum of 03 years of relevant work experience after completion of internship, and valid registration with the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine or an equivalent State Medicine Board/Council.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the ECHS Bhopal Ayurveda Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: B. Pharma or D Pharma (Ayurveda) from a college recognized by Central/State Govt, a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience, and valid registration in the concerned State/UT.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for ECHS Bhopal Ayurveda posts?
faq.answer: The fixed remuneration is 95,000/- per month for the Ayurveda Doctor and 36,500/- per month for the Ayurveda Pharmacist.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for ECHS Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the format given on www.echs.gov.in, attach self attested photocopies of qualification and experience testimonials and a medical fitness certificate from SEMO/CMO, and submit it to OIC, Stn HQ (ECHS Cell), Sultania Infantry Lines, Bhopal, PIN 462001.

faq.question: Q7. When is the ECHS Bhopal interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 20 November 2026 between 0930 hrs and 1400 hrs; candidates must reach Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Bhopal at 0900 hrs, and only eligible candidates will be intimated by SMS.

faq.question: Q8. Is the ECHS Bhopal job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is on a contractual basis up to 31 Mar 2027 only, renewable for an additional period / till attaining the maximum age subject to performance and other conditions.

faq.question: Q9. Do Ex-Servicemen get preference in ECHS Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen, who must bring their discharge book, PPO and service records to the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for the ECHS Bhopal interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA is admissible.
